title: Festival Showdown
guardrail: Made-up numbers. Real life is different.

start.tagline: Be the treasurer. ₹50,000 on paper. What will really arrive?
start.codeNote: No name needed. The code just saves your game on this phone.

brief.l1: Welcome, treasurer! The colony festival needs ₹50,000.
brief.l2: Let's see where that money really comes from.

event.name: Event day
event.note: Tickets and stalls, only on the day

brief.whatText: Confirmed money is in hand and can pay a bill today. Promised money is only a promise until it arrives.

goals.title: Pick 3 goals, in order
goals.sub: Rank 1 matters most. Money spent on one goal can make another wait.

G1.name: Kids' fun
G1.need: A kids' corner, open all day

G3.name: Lights and sound
G3.need: Good lights, and sound that reaches the whole crowd

G5.name: Packed and safe
G5.need: At least 420 visitors, and a safety pack

p1.label: Quick guess
p1.q: This year, the same shopping list will cost…
p1.note: Your answer is revealed at the end. A wrong guess costs nothing.

market.title: The market
market.actionsNote: Haggling, paying later and reading fine print each cost 1 action.

chacha.name: Chacha
chacha.tag: Friendly. Pays later, for a fee.

big.name: Big sound
big.desc: Sound for 600 people. A technician is required.

reliable.name: Reliable sound
reliable.desc: Sound for 600 people, with a backup

plates.name: Plates
plates.desc: Food per plate. Pick how many.

combo.name: Combo
combo.desc: Big sound, good lights and a safety pack

sheet.payLater: Pay it all on Festival Day, +5% · 1 action
sheet.fine: Fine print: a required add-on of {{amount}}, billed {{when}}.
sheet.unread: Total: the price above, plus anything in the fine print.
sheet.qtyNote: Unused plates are still paid. Too few means rush plates on the day.
sheet.drop: Take it out of the plan

blocked.sameKind: You already signed one of these. Take it out of the plan to swap.
blocked.combo: The Combo already includes sound, lights and a safety pack.

sheet.toast: Signed. Fine print: required add-on {{amount}}. Total {{total}}.
sheet.arjunBig: Go big! More sound, more crowd.
sheet.arjunCombo: Everything in one deal. Sign it now!
sheet.ayeshaBasic: Read what is not in the price.
sheet.ayeshaGeneral: Check when each payment is due.

P2.q: Which costs less in total: Basic sound or Reliable sound?

P4.q: Which costs less: the Combo, or the same three things bought one by one?

opts.parts: The same things one by one

P3.q: If the sponsor pays a week late, can we still pay the Week 3 bills?

lines.title: Your money, date by date
lines.note: Bills shown are the ones you signed, plus permits. Surprise bills are not included.
lines.fd: On Festival Day, the line also counts the event money you expect.

check.title: Plan check
check.lockNote: After this, the plan is frozen. The dates play out.
check.needAnswer: Answer the guess to lock the plan.

date.needChoice: Make your choice to go on.

cards.W1: Permits are due, and the first payments go out.
cards.W2none: Rao uncle's donation did not come.
cards.W2bill: Surprise! An electrical fault. The repair is a bill.
cards.W3: The second hall payment is due.
cards.FDsponsor: The sponsor's money arrives this morning.
cards.FDrush: You ordered {{plates}} plates. {{n}} rush plates cost {{cost}} extra.
cards.FDowed: {{money}} stayed unpaid. It is recorded as owed.

cast.sunny: Trust me. I know a guy.
cast.shobha: The big day. Let's count the crowd.

e2.title: A bigger stage?
e2.body: The donation is in. A bigger stage costs ₹5,000.
e2.note: A bigger stage draws about 10% more visitors. More visitors need more plates.

e4.title: Sunny's offer
e4.body: Sunny can buy speakers if you give him ₹2,000 now.

short.title: The bills are more than the cash
short.pick: Choose what happens to each bill. Nothing is marked as better.
short.fd: A bill can't move past Festival Day.
short.owedNote: On Festival Day an unpaid bill is recorded as owed, with a 10% fee.
